notes.title: We're taking part in GALM 2025!
notes.content: [p]Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43610542/7cf283f9e171cf0ca433afd9dbca39011dbbaac7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Running from 8–15 September, to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, we’re proud to take part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025 - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape.[/p][previewyoutube="buDprkaYtog;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Why is it important?[/p][list][*][p]1 in 4 of us will have suicidal thoughts.[/p][/*][*][p]125 people die by suicide every week.[/p][/*][*][p]Someone attempts suicide every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Suicide is the biggest killer of men under 50. [/p][/*][*][p]Suicide is the leading cause of death for people aged 15-39.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s presented by Curve Games and the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably. By taking part, we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work.[/p][p]So, grab a game (or two) and play your part against suicide.[/p]

notes.title: We're taking part in Clemmy's BIG Fall Showcase!
notes.content:
[p][b]We’re in Clemmy’s BIG Fall Showcase![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43610542/cbfe6d99c6563dc7b8b0c549821a216771095a88.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Nine Rounds Rapid[/i] will be featured in [b][url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClemmyGames"]Clemmy’s BIG Fall Showcase[/url][/b] - a huge celebration of upcoming indie games![/p][p][b]When & Where[/b]
The showcase will be live on [b]YouTube[/b] and streaming right here on [b]Steam[/b] on the second of September, 8am pacific time. Expect a packed lineup of awesome indies — and of course, a fresh look at [i]NINE ROUNDS RAPID[/i].[/p][p]Don’t miss it! Come hang out, discover some amazing games, and see what’s new aboard the possessed, crumbling station we call home.[/p][p]Add [i]NINE ROUNDS RAPID[/i] to your wishlist and follow our page so you don’t lose track[/p]
